        On May 15, 2026, Oncor Electric Delivery Company LLC and LCRA Transmission Ser-
vices Corporation filed their first List of Intervenors Who Did Not File Testimony or a Statement
of Position, 1 which includes intervenors James Stainton and John Gilbert. 2
        Mr. Stainton and Mr. Gilbert are members of and aligned with the M31, M32, and M33
Opposition Landowners in this proceeding. 3 And the M31, M32, and M33 Opposition Landowners
timely filed direct testimony for eight witnesses by the May 13, 2026 filing deadline. 4
        So Mr. Stainton and Mr. Gilbert (1) should be removed from the list of intervenors who
allegedly did not timely file direct testimony or a statement of position and (2) should not be sub-
ject to dismissal from this proceeding.

        1
          Oncor and LCRA TSC’s List of Intervenors Who Did Not File Direct Testimony or a Statement of Position

2026).
